# Aggregate review scope

Read for a final aggregate code or code-slop review before inspecting changes.

Cover the entire delivery and cross-task integration, including parked findings. Read relevant prior findings and controller rulings; preserve stable finding IDs and distinguish ruled findings from new regressions. Apply the assigned role: code review assesses correctness and readiness; code-slop review assesses material, behavior-preserving simplifications.

**Complete when:** the report accounts for the whole assigned delivery, cross-task risks, relevant prior rulings, and any coverage limits. Return to the agent's normal report contract; acceptance remains controller-owned.
